text: The facet comment describes entries as [group object, list of items], and the comparator accesses indices 0 and 1. The lint follow-up gives aGroups the broad {object} type. For this function, a more precise array-and-tuple description would communicate the actual contract better than validator acceptance alone. This is a proposed local documentation improvement, not an existing project-wide JSDoc type rule. This is static source evidence. No runtime, build or live accessibility validation was run. Full bug and review discussion remains pending.
title: Document a facet tuple shape beyond a validator-compatible object tag
